title: Main board - component side - raptox's unit (AN600-20 EU, opened 2026-11-01)
source: Own photo, raptox's unit, 2026-11-01: images/own/2026-11-01/05_main-board_component-side.jpg (downscaled 3072x4080 -> 1205x1600); markings read from the chips/ close-ups

callouts.label: TI CC3220S Wi-Fi MCU
callouts.part: CC3220SM2ARGK, VQFN-64; no internal flash, boots from U15/U16
callouts.note: Refdes U1 read on the board. Date code 92J (FCC sample: different lot).

callouts.label: XMC XM25QH64A SPI NOR flash, 64 Mbit (8 MiB)
callouts.part: XM25QH64AHIG: SOP-8 208 mil, 2.7-3.6 V, JEDEC ID 20 70 17
callouts.note: CC3220 serial flash: firmware + SimpleLink filesystem. PRIMARY DUMP TARGET. Wide body (208 mil): use a SOIC-8 clip that fits 208 mil. Date code 1830 = 2018 wk 30.

callouts.label: QFN-40 IC 'T3018' - unidentified
callouts.note: Marking legible but part not identified yet. Central position with many traces toward the LED side: LED/touch driver or a third MCU? Not the Lumissil IS31FL3018 (that is QFN-32).

callouts.label: QFN-20 IC '4637' next to the speaker connector
callouts.part: QFN-20, about 3x3 mm, TP21-TP27 around it
callouts.note: Location next to J9 (speaker) suggests an audio/speaker driver. Unidentified.

callouts.label: onsemi NCP59800 LDO (DFN-8)
callouts.part: DFN-8; C577/C579 bulk MLCCs, R589/R590 divider, C604
callouts.marking: 59800 / ADJB / GAJL (read 'S9800 / A0J8' before; the mosaic and the datasheet settle it)
callouts.note: Identified on the microscope mosaic (J-076): adjustable 1 A low-noise LDO making the 3.3 V rail. C577 input, C579 output, C604 noise-reduction cap, R589/R590 feedback divider.

callouts.label: 3-hole header footprint - UNPOPULATED
callouts.part: 1x3, 2.54 mm, pin 3 marked; R573/R579/R580, TP28/TP29 next to it
callouts.note: Header was fitted on the FCC sample, empty on the production unit. Prime UART candidate (TX/RX/GND). Map by continuity to the CC3220 UART pins.

callouts.label: 4-way DIP switch footprint - UNPOPULATED
callouts.part: 8 pads, silkscreen 'DIP', pin 1 marked; R533/R535/R577 next to it
callouts.note: Switch fitted on the FCC sample only. Strong candidate for the CC3220 SOP boot-mode straps: map the pads to SOP0/1/2 and nRESET.

callouts.label: Tag-Connect TC2030 footprint (6 pads + 3 holes)
callouts.note: JTAG/SWD (CC3220) or cJTAG (CC2640R2F). J38 is the twin on the LED side.

callouts.label: Boxed test-point group (R17-R21, R585, C101)
callouts.note: Silkscreen box groups 5 test points with series resistors. Production-test or programming access?

callouts.label: Test points beside the CC2640R2F
callouts.note: Traces run straight into U7. Candidates: cJTAG (TMSC/TCKC), reset or UART.

callouts.label: Test points under exposed copper pad
Crystal near J29 (32.768 kHz RTC for CC3220?)
CC3220 DC/DC inductors + caps
callouts.note: The CC3220 has internal DC/DC converters that need external inductors.

callouts.label: Exposed copper pads (spring contacts on FCC sample)
callouts.note: The FCC sample had metal spring fingers here. Ground/shield contacts to the housing?

callouts.label: Heat-stake posts (board riveted to the bezel)
callouts.note: No need to remove them: everything we need is on this side.
